subject: Covenant Health RFP: Operator access, egress controls, and SBOM evidence
messages:
From: Lisa Morris <lisa.morris@covenanthealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@covenanthealth.com>, Covenant Security <security@covenanthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Apr 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP Q: operator access / egress / SBOM — Covenant Health

Kimberly,

Thank you for taking our RFP. We've been combing through vendor responses and need a focused capability pack for on-prem and VPC/private delivery. Specifically Covenant security and procurement teams asked for:

- A completed capability matrix that maps operator access levels, KMS/HSM integration points, and egress controls for air-gapped and VPC installs.
- SBOM extract (top-level components + provenance) and patch cadence for agent/runtime.
- Network diagram showing allowed egress, operator bastion, and update channels.
- A short operator runbook excerpt showing how emergency patching and incident artifact export are performed in an air-gapped site.

Can you provide the materials and call out any required Covenant responsibilities (e.g., physical operator station, separate provisioning network)? We are trying to validate against our procurement checklist and will share the internal SOW once we validate controls.

Appreciate a target delivery by EOD 30 Apr if possible; procurement can extend to Wed if needed.

Best,
Lisa Morris
Director, Vendor Risk & Security
Covenant Health Systems
Attachments: covenant-rfp-template.pdf (requested items list)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Morris <lisa.morris@covenanthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Apr 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP Q: operator access / egress / SBOM — Covenant Health

Lisa — thanks for the clear ask. I've filled the capability matrix and attached supporting artifacts below. High-level notes up front:

- We support three deployment modes relevant to Covenant: Hosted, Dedicated (customer VPC peering), and Private (customer-managed VPC or on-prem air-gapped). This thread focuses on Private/VPC and air-gapped operator workflows.
- Operator access model: role-based with separation of duties. Customer-managed operator bastion recommended for air-gapped installs; Redwood can run an operator appliance if required under contract.
- KMS/HSM: Bring-your-own-KMS supported via cloud KMS integrations for Dedicated; for on-prem we integrate with customer HSMs over PKCS#11 or use offline-encrypted keyrings.
- Egress: default closed by policy. Optional egress paths exist for updates, telemetry, and license checks — explicit allowlist required from Covenant. We document acceptable mechanisms and fallbacks.

Attached (zipped): covenant_rfp_matrix_filled.xlsx (matrix), sbom_summary.csv (top-level SBOM), network-diagram.png, operator-access-runbook.pdf.

Quick asks on our side:
1) Do you require SOC 2 Type II snapshot as part of this RFP (we can provide summary evidence and link to auditor report under NDA)?
2) For air-gapped—we'll need a designated provisioning machine (operator VM) with temporary admin connectivity for initial install and patch airlift. We call this out in the runbook.

If you want, Ben and Vanessa can hop on a 30-min tech call tomorrow to walk the diagram and runbook.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: covenant_rfp_matrix_filled.xlsx (attachment), sbom_summary.csv (attachment), network-diagram.png (attachment), operator-access-runbook.pdf (attachment)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Lisa Morris <lisa.morris@covenanthealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 May 2029 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP Q: operator access / egress / SBOM — Covenant Health

Lisa / Kimberly — quick technical clarifications from our infra side:

1) SBOM: the attached sbom_summary.csv is a filtered export (runtime + direct libs). If Covenant needs full provenance including build containers and base OS layers we can provide a signed SBOM bundle (CycloneDX) under NDA; would you like that?

2) Patch cadence: default runtime patch window is monthly with emergency hotfixes pushed as needed. For air-gapped sites we provide signed patch artifacts and a documented airlift process; operator must approve inbound media.

3) Network diagram details: in air-gapped mode the only outbound channel we recommend for license/telemetry is an operator-initiated push through a controlled jump host. No persistent outbound sockets are required. See network-diagram.png (attached).

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, 30 Apr 2029 at 10:05 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > Attached (zipped): covenant_rfp_matrix_filled.xlsx (matrix), sbom_summary.csv (top-level SBOM), network-diagram.png, operator-access-runbook.pdf.

If Covenant security prefers, we can provide a small PoC runbook and do a walkthrough in a closed session.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Morris <lisa.morris@covenanthealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 May 2029 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP Q: operator access / egress / SBOM — Covenant Health

Lisa — following up with the operator runbook excerpt and a short checklist for install day. See the runbook excerpt attached (operator-access-runbook.pdf). Key operator responsibilities called out include:

- Provisioning host: isolated admin workstation with USB-enabled patch airlift (operator signs and verifies artifacts).
- Physical access controls: operator must have local console access to the appliance for emergency maintenance.
- Certificate provisioning: customer CA or Redwood-signed certs are supported; we prefer customer CA in private installs.
- Emergency telemetry: artifact export requires an operator-signed package; we include checksums and signature verification steps.

We also attached a redlined SLA (redlined-sla.docx) showing proposed language around update windows and emergency response in air-gapped deployments.

If Covenant can confirm whether the operator workstation will be under Covenant control or a third-party integrator, we'll mark the runbook steps accordingly.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Field Operations — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
Attachments: operator-access-runbook.pdf (attachment), redlined-sla.docx (attachment)
From: Lisa Morris <lisa.morris@covenanthealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@covenanthealth.com>, Covenant Security <security@covenanthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2029 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP Q: operator access / egress / SBOM — Covenant Health

Kimberly / Vanessa / Ben — thanks for the rapid, thorough packet. Covenant Security reviewed the matrix and runbook excerpt; a few next steps from procurement/security:

1) Please provide a SOC 2 Type II summary and a copy of the auditor letter under NDA (we will circulate our NDA; we can also accept a secured link).
2) We would like the full CycloneDX SBOM bundle for runtime+build provenance. NDA requested.
3) Procurement requests the signed redlined SLA (we'll send an initial SOW and suggested edit set).

If you can upload the artifacts to the HubSpot record and to the DocuSign agreement link below, we'll expedite internal review. Also, can you confirm the expected on-prem resource footprint (CPU/GPU, storage) for a 100-concurrent-session deployment? We need numbers for our capacity planning team.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/agreements/ABCDEF123456
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Targeting a procurement decision in mid-May pending NDA and SOC2 evidence. Appreciate the teams' responsiveness.

Best,
Lisa Morris
Director, Vendor Risk & Security
Covenant Health Systems
Attachments: covenant_internal_sow_draft.docx (we will share after NDA)
